title: My English family
instructions: Elif Londra'da yanında kaldığı aileyi anlatıyor. Uzun bir metin; kim kimdir, karıştırma. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: s
script.text: My name is Elif, and I am a student in London.

script.speaker: s
script.text: I am from Turkey, but now I live with an English family.

script.speaker: s
script.text: There are four people in the family: Mr and Mrs Smith and their two children, Tom and Lucy.

script.speaker: s
script.text: Tom is ten and Lucy is seven. They are very funny.

script.speaker: s
script.text: Mr Smith is a bus driver, and Mrs Smith works in a bank.

script.speaker: s
script.text: I have English lessons every morning from nine to one.

script.speaker: s
script.text: In the afternoon, I help Lucy with her homework, and Tom teaches me English words.

script.speaker: s
script.text: The food is different here. I miss Turkish breakfast, but I love English fish and chips!

questions.evidence: Tom is ten and Lucy is seven.

questions.feedback: Bayan Smith bankada çalışıyor; otobüs şoförü Bay Smith.
questions.evidence: Mrs Smith works in a bank.

questions.prompt: When does Elif have English lessons?
questions.evidence: I have English lessons every morning
